channel.title: HotNews — China, every day.
channel.description: Daily stories about China in technology, finance, sports, entertainment, lifestyle, science, travel and culture — for readers around the world.

item.title: Chinese Phone Giant Infinix Unveils World-First Gaming Controller and Cooling Dock
item.description: Infinix, the gaming-focused brand of Shenzhen-based Transsion, has launched two GT NX accessories: a controller with the world's first pixel-precision touchpad for shooters and a dock with built-in thermoelectric cooling. The launch signals a push by China's low-profile phone giants into high-margin mobile gaming gear.

item.title: AI Takes Over Sophisticated Investment Scams
item.description: Chinese investors face new wave of AI-powered financial fraud as artificial intelligence enables more sophisticated 'pig butchering' scams that manipulate victims into transferring large sums.

item.title: China's Audio Gear Makes Big Noise in Southeast Asia
item.description: From a small Shenzhen shop to 500,000 monthly sales in Southeast Asia, Chinese audio brands are thriving overseas by adapting products to local consumer needs.

item.title: China's Auto Industry Faces New Turn in Evolutionary Cycle
item.description: Four signals indicate China's car industry stands at the threshold of a new consolidation phase as market forces reshape the competitive landscape.

item.title: China's Lithium Battery Boom Faces Graphite Challenge
item.description: China's lithium battery industry announces 740,000 ton expansion amid concerns about graphite supply bottlenecks that could impact EV production.

item.title: China's Smartphone Giants Switch Chip Suppliers
item.description: Major Chinese phone makers OPPO and vivo unexpectedly switch to MediaTek chips for flagship models, signaling industry shifts amid intense competition.

item.title: Lithium Battery Market: Reality Meets Hype
item.description: While the market fears oversupply, lithium batteries remain紧缺. Two critical supply factors are being underestimated as demand continues to grow.

item.title: Chinese Tea Traditions in Modern Times
item.description: Ancient Chinese tea ceremonies are evolving with contemporary lifestyles, blending millennia-old traditions with modern innovations to create new cultural experiences.

item.title: Traditional Meets Digital: China's Digital Museum Boom
item.description: China's cultural institutions are embracing digital technology to preserve and share ancient artifacts with global audiences, creating immersive experiences that bridge millennia.

item.title: 380,000 AI Dramas Later: China's Animation Gold Rush Hits Reality
item.description: Producers unleashed hundreds of thousands of AI-generated animated mini-dramas onto Chinese platforms this year, only to see payouts shrink and studios fold. As the bubble deflates, survivors are turning to lessons from Japan's 1980s anime boom for a way forward.

item.title: China's Animation Industry Captures Global Imagination
item.description: China's animation sector is rapidly evolving from domestic entertainment to international acclaim, blending traditional cultural elements with cutting-edge technology to create globally appealing content.

item.title: China's Animation Industry Captures Global Imagination
item.description: Once heavily influenced by foreign styles, China's animation industry now blends traditional cultural elements with cutting-edge technology to create content resonating worldwide.

item.title: Feng Xiaogang's Box Office Flop Finds Redemption on Chinese Streaming
item.description: Dismissed at the Chinese box office, Feng Xiaogang's latest film has found its audience after moving to streaming, topping Tencent Video's heat rankings within days. The turnaround reignites a familiar debate about why China's pioneering commercial director keeps winning recognition only after the credits roll.

item.title: You Benchang, Beloved 'Ji Gong' Actor, Dies at 93
item.description: You Benchang, the Chinese actor whose tattered-robe portrayal of the legendary 'mad monk' Ji Gong charmed generations of viewers, has died in Beijing at 93. After decades of small stage roles, he found fame at 52 and won a new generation of fans at 90 in the hit drama 'Blossoms Shanghai.'

item.title: China's Digital Yuan Leading Global CBDC Race
item.description: China's digital currency is rapidly advancing with expanded pilot programs and growing merchant acceptance, positioning the nation at the forefront of central bank digital currency development worldwide.

item.title: China's Digital Yuan Leads Global CBDC Revolution
item.description: China's digital currency is pioneering the future of global finance, offering a glimpse into how nations might reshape money in the digital age.

item.title: China's 'Miracle Stock' Crashes 67% Just Days After IPO
item.description: Shengu Group, a veteran Chinese maker of giant industrial compressors, saw its shares collapse 67 percent within six days of a dazzling stock market debut. The whiplash offers a vivid lesson in the speculative frenzy gripping China's market for new listings.

item.title: China's Stock Market Soars While Investors Wonder
item.description: Despite two years of impressive gains, China's A-share market has created a puzzling scenario where indices have risen significantly while many individual investors report losses.

item.title: China's Two-Year Bull Market: Index Up 45%, Yet Investors Still Sigh
item.description: Two years after Chinese stocks rebounded from their September 2024 lows, the Shanghai Composite has climbed about 45 percent and market capitalization has swelled by roughly 51 trillion yuan. Yet many retail investors say their own accounts tell a far less celebratory story of widening wealth divergence.

item.title: Chinese Biotech Stock Soars 477% on Debut
item.description: Chinese biotech firm BaiRuiJi sees explosive 477% surge on first trading day after Beijing Stock Exchange listing, showcasing investor enthusiasm for healthcare innovation.

item.title: Chinese Company Wins $132M US Data Center Contract
item.description: Samsung Electric's Chinese subsidiary secures major US contract for data center transformers amid market volatility and stock fluctuations.

item.title: Chinese Game Combines Ancient Elements with Modern Match-3
item.description: New game 'Wuxing You' merges traditional Chinese five elements theory with popular match-3 gameplay, launching across multiple platforms with cross-platform multiplayer support.

item.title: Chinese Transformer Maker Rides US Data Center Boom With $132 Million Order
item.description: Sanxing Electric, a Ningbo-based power equipment maker, surged its 10 percent daily limit after its subsidiary won a $132 million contract to supply oil-immersed transformers for a US data center energy storage project. The deal shows how the global AI building boom is pulling Chinese manufacturers into America's power infrastructure chain.

item.title: Chinese Game 'Five Elements' Merges Ancient Philosophy with Modern Puzzle Battles
item.description: A new Chinese game combines traditional Five Elements theory with match-3 gameplay, creating a unique multiplayer experience across all devices.

item.title: Chinese Game Scene Thrives with Diverse Titles
item.description: China's gaming industry showcases its diversity with a VR courtroom drama, a hand-painted horror adventure, and a live-action interactive story, reflecting the country's growing creative output in the global gaming market.

item.title: Donkey Kong's Final Banana Bash Delights Gamers
item.description: Nintendo wraps up a year of themed events with the 'Banana Frenzy Carnival' expansion in Donkey Kong: Banana Bliss. The week-long event offers players non-stop challenges on the 1400th underground level.

item.title: Warhammer 40K: Dawn of War 4 Team Battle Report
item.description: Creative director and senior designer showcase 2v2 team gameplay in the upcoming Warhammer 40K: Dawn of War 4, revealing tactical insights for the December 3 release.

item.title: China's Coffee Culture Brewing Creative Home Mixes
item.description: Chinese coffee enthusiasts are crafting unique homemade beverages as specialty coffee culture grows nationwide, blending traditional flavors with modern techniques.

item.title: Here Wallpaper: Turning Places into Personalized Backgrounds
item.description: A new app transforms favorite locations into stunning wallpapers, allowing users to bring memories of home, travel destinations, or beloved natural scenes to their digital devices.

item.title: Vintage Computer Collection Turns Ten
item.description: A decade-long journey through China's unique tech community reveals how personal passion transformed into cultural phenomenon, reshaping perceptions of technology preservation.

item.title: Vintage Computer Lab: A Decade of Tech Collection
item.description: From a business experiment to a cultural journey, one man's ten-year journey with vintage computers in China reveals how technology and passion converge.

item.title: China's Green Revolution in Agricultural Technology
item.description: China is pioneering sustainable farming solutions to feed its population while combating climate change, with innovations that could transform global agriculture.

item.title: China's Basketball Renaissance: From Courts to Global Stardom
item.description: China's basketball scene is experiencing unprecedented growth, producing NBA stars and hosting international competitions that showcase the nation's passion for the sport.

item.title: China's Tennis Team Falls Short in Billie Jean King Cup Quarterfinals
item.description: China's tennis team lost 1-2 to defending champions Italy in the Billie Jean King Cup quarterfinals. Zheng Qinwen played through pain medication as China's quest for a semifinal spot ended at home.

item.title: China's Quantum Computing: The Next Frontier
item.description: China advances quantum research with breakthroughs that could revolutionize computing and cryptography while positioning itself as a global leader in next-generation technology.

item.title: Japan Ends 36-Year Chinese Reign in Asian Games Table Tennis Final
item.description: Japan's men stunned China 3-2 in the Asian Games team table tennis final in Nagoya, claiming their first gold in 60 years and ending a 36-year Chinese hold on the title. China's women responded with a 3-0 win over Japan for a sixth straight crown.

item.title: Japan Stuns China in Asian Games Table Tennis, Women Answer with Gold
item.description: Japan edged China 3-2 in a gripping men's team final at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, denying the table tennis superpower a familiar crown. Hours later, China's women swept Japan 3-0 to win a sixth consecutive team title, restoring pride on a dramatic day in Nagoya.

item.title: Pain and Pride: China's Billie Jean King Cup Dream Ends in Shenzhen
item.description: Zheng Qinwen took the court on painkillers and fell to Jasmine Paolini as defending champions Italy edged China 2-1 in the Billie Jean King Cup quarterfinal in Shenzhen. Veteran Zhang Shuai had fired the hosts ahead, but Italy's depth proved decisive, sending the Italians into a semifinal against Ukraine.

item.title: Table Tennis: China's National Passion
item.description: From schoolyards to Olympic glory, table tennis has become China's beloved national sport, uniting generations and showcasing the country's athletic excellence on the global stage.

item.title: BYD's Next-Gen Dolphin Interior Redefines EV Design
item.description: BYD unveils design sketches for its second-generation Dolphin model, featuring a revolutionary interior layout with relocated controls and innovative storage options.
